reproduction_target: Computational whole-genome-sequencing analysis pipeline for 686 S. aureus isolates (raw Illumina reads in ENA PRJEB59751): read QC/trimming (TrimGalore), taxonomic ID/contamination (Kraken2, Mash), de novo assembly (SKESA), reference variant calling vs NC_007795.1 (Snippy), annotation (Prokka), pangenome (Roary), core-genome phylogeny (FastTree2), MLST (ABRicate MLST), AMR gene detection (ABRicate over CARD/ResFinder/VFDB; DeepARG), SCCmec/mecA typing (staphopia-sccmec, minimap2, SCCmec_CLA workflow), spa typing (spaTyper), and pangenome-wide GWAS (Scoary). Whole pipeline implemented in CWL and executed on a local Arvados system; source/workflow/config repo at github.com/bio-ontology-research-group/mrsa-sequences.
granularity_note: Stage-2 code-check read the mrsa-sequences repo at line level: workflows/ (CWL CommandLineTool defs + input JSONs), dockers/roary2svg/Dockerfile, requirements.txt, setup.py, runinvenv.sh, analyzer/ DB-postprocessing scripts (card_data.py, resfinder_data.py, deeparg_data.py, meca.py, cluster_mec.py), run_rgi.sh, run_resfinder.sh, db/ (mecA.fasta, metadata.rdf.gz). Coarse one-step-per-named-tool granularity preserved from Stage-1. IMPORTANT code-vs-prose divergences found: (a) the committed CWL covers a SUBSET of the paper's tools plus extra tools the paper does not list (augur, iqtree, odgi/seqwish/pggb graph-pangenome, deepgoplus, rgi, circos, snp-dists); (b) several paper-named tools have NO invocation in the repo — Mash, spaTyper, and Scoary are absent entirely (no CWL, no script), DeepARG appears only as result post-processing (deeparg_data.py) with no in-repo invocation/container, FastTree2 is replaced in code by iqtree 1.6.9, ABRicate-MLST is replaced by Torsten Seemann mlst 2.19.0, and staphopia-sccmec is replaced by a custom minimap2-vs-db/mecA.fasta method; (c) minimap2 CWL pins 2.17 whereas the paper states 2.24-r1122 (version mismatch); (d) the SCCmec_CLA external workflow (cdnstp/SCCmec_CLA) is not referenced anywhere in the repo (not in CWL, not in README) — floating. Wet-lab steps (culture, VITEK-2 AST, DNA isolation, library prep, NovaSeq sequencing, collection) remain layer W, not verdicted.

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 13/18 computational steps (down from 15 at Stage-1). The code-check confirmed in-code tool-version pins for the steps that have real CWL CommandLineTool defs (trim_galore 0.4.4, kraken2 2.0.8_beta, skesa 2.4.0, snippy 4.6.0 with reference accession NC_007795.1 pinned in snippy.json, prokka 1.14.6, roary 3.13.0, abricate 1.0.1, mlst 2.19.0, minimap2 2.17) — this is an UPGRADE from prose-only to verified-in-code for the version dimension, and CWL+input-JSON now expose invocation params (params axis bumped to 2 for those steps). BUT every container reference is a MUTABLE tag (e.g. quay.io/biocontainers/abricate:1.0.1--h1341992_0, staphb/skesa:2.4.0, kerstenbreuer/trim_galore:0.4.4_1.14_0.11.7) or a floating :latest (coolmaksat/circos:latest, finlaymaguire/rgi:latest, coolmaksat/snippy:latest, coolmaksat/roary2svg:latest, commonworkflowlanguage/cwltool_module) — NONE pinned by @sha256 digest. The container_digest_claim is REFUTED: there is no image digest, no conda-lock, no pixi/renv lock anywhere; requirements.txt uses plain pip == pins WITHOUT hashes and pins only the Arvados/cwltool harness, not the bioinformatics tools; the single Dockerfile (dockers/roary2svg) is FROM ubuntu:18.04 (mutable) and curls master. Two steps DOWNGRADED RI→NI because their paper-named tool is absent from the repo entirely (Mash C3, spaTyper C17). Three steps stay NI (VFDB unpinned C13, SCCmec_CLA unreferenced/floating C16, Scoary unpinned+absent C18). Additional code-vs-prose divergences: FastTree2→iqtree 1.6.9, ABRicate-MLST→mlst 2.19.0, staphopia-sccmec→custom minimap2+db/mecA.fasta, minimap2 2.17(code) vs 2.24-r1122(paper). No step exceeds RI without a validated, digest/lock-closed environment capture.

gaps.where: Code-vs-prose tool divergences: C3 Mash, C8 FastTree2, C9 ABRicate-MLST, C12 DeepARG, C14 staphopia-sccmec, C15 minimap2, C17 spaTyper, C18 Scoary
gaps.missing: The committed repo does not implement the paper's stated toolset faithfully. Mash, spaTyper and Scoary have NO invocation in the repo (absent); DeepARG appears only as result post-processing; FastTree2 is replaced by iqtree 1.6.9; ABRicate-MLST is replaced by mlst 2.19.0; staphopia-sccmec is replaced by a custom minimap2-vs-db/mecA.fasta method; minimap2 CWL pins 2.17 while the paper states 2.24-r1122. A reader cannot reproduce the paper's stated pipeline from this repo without resolving these substitutions.
gaps.how_to_close: Commit the CWL/scripts for the missing tools (Mash, spaTyper, Scoary, DeepARG invocation, staphopia-sccmec) at pinned versions, reconcile FastTree2 vs iqtree and ABRicate-MLST vs mlst and minimap2 2.17 vs 2.24 between Methods and code, and pin the SCCmec_CLA external workflow to a commit.

gaps.where: External DB/reference acquisition (C2 Kraken2 DB, C10 CARD, C11 ResFinder, C13 VFDB, C16 SCCmec_CLA)
gaps.missing: No external database is obtained via an in-code pinned accession/release/checksum (Lever 2 FALSE). Kraken2 DB is a local unversioned minikraken directory path (kraken.json: /home/kulmanm/data/dbs/minikraken); CARD is bundled in the mutable rgi:5.1.1 image and run via run_rgi.sh with a hardcoded host path; ResFinder is mounted from an unversioned local host path (run_resfinder.sh); VFDB is whatever ships inside abricate:1.0.1 (abricate.json db=vfdb); SCCmec_CLA is an external floating repo not referenced in code. Only the Snippy reference accession NC_007795.1 (C5) and the in-repo db/mecA.fasta (C15, git-content-pinned) are genuinely pinned — insufficient for the ALL-class-A requirement.
gaps.how_to_close: Fetch each DB by pinned release/accession + checksum inside the workflow (Kraken2 DB build date/hash, CARD release, ResFinder release, VFDB snapshot date), and pin SCCmec_CLA to a commit.
